I've played twice, and hated it both times. It seemed to boil down to trying to persuade people to help you for a while, a comparison of pretty random numbers on cards, and an exchange that basically goes, "I win!" "No you don't!" "Yes I do!" "Aha! Now nobody wins!" It's like Munchkin but without the vaguely amusing card names and illustrations.
